description:
PROBLEM TYPE: LP

PROBLEM INFO:

- A delivery person starts at the intersection of \var{1}th Avenue and \var{1}th Street and needs to reach the intersection of \var{W}th Avenue and \var{N}th Street.
- The path between these two points forms a \var{N-1} × \var{W-1} grid.
- Each block on the grid has a unique walking time due to varying pedestrian traffic during rush hour.
- The delivery person can only walk north or west.
- The journey can be broken down into \var{m} stages, where at each stage the delivery person decides to walk either north or west.
- When at the intersection of \var{w}th Avenue and \var{n}th Street, the time to move to the intersection of \var{w+1}th Avenue and \var{n}th Stree is \var{west_time_{n,w}}.
- When at the intersection of \var{w}th Avenue and \var{n}th Street, the time to move to the intersection of \var{w}th Avenue and \var{n+1}th Stree is \var{north_time_{n,w}}.

INPUT FORMAT:

{
    "west_time": [[west_{n,w} for w in 1, ..., W-1] for n in 1, ..., N],
    "north_time": [[north_{n,w} for w in 1, ..., W] for n in 1, ..., N-1],
}

OBJECTIVE: Determine the optimal path the delivery person should take to ensure the package is delivered in the least amount of time.

OUTPUT INFO:

- \var{total_time} represents total time taken to travel this path
- \var{paths} represents the flow going through the corresponding path

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "paths": [(street_{n}, avenue_{w}) for id in 1, ..., m]
    "total_time": total_travel_time
}

WestTime.definition: Time to cross street segment going west, for given street n and segment w

NorthTime.definition: Time to cross street segment going north, for given street n and segment w

objective.description: "Minimize the total travel time required for the delivery person to travel from the intersection of 1st Avenue and 1st Street to the intersection of Wth Avenue and Nth Street."

constraints.description: Flow balance constraint: At the start node (1,1), total outgoing flow minus total incoming flow equals 1; at the destination node (N,W), total incoming flow minus total outgoing flow equals 1; at all other intersections, total incoming flow equals total outgoing flow
constraints.formulation:
$\text{Start node } (1,1): \quad WestFlow[1,1] + NorthFlow[1,1] = 1$ 

$\text{Destination node } (N,W): \quad WestFlow[N,W-1] + NorthFlow[N-1,W] = 1$ 

$\forall n = 1, \dots, N,\; \forall w = 1, \dots, W,$ for $(n,w) \neq (1,1)$ and $(n,w) \neq (N,W)$:

$\big( \mathbb{1}_{\{w < W\}} \, WestFlow[n,w] + \mathbb{1}_{\{n < N\}} \, NorthFlow[n,w] \big)
-
\big( \mathbb{1}_{\{w > 1\}} \, WestFlow[n,w-1] + \mathbb{1}_{\{n > 1\}} \, NorthFlow[n-1,w] \big) = 0$

constraints.description: Flow is allowed only on arcs from (n,w) to (n+1,w) (north) and from (n,w) to (n,w+1) (west)
constraints.formulation: $\\forall n = 1, \\dots, N, \\; \\forall w = 1, \\dots, W-1: \\; WestFlow[n,w] \\in \\{0,1\\}$\n\n$\\forall n = 1, \\dots, N-1, \\; \\forall w = 1, \\dots, W: \\; NorthFlow[n,w] \\in \\{0,1\\}$

constraints.description: All path decision (flow) variables must be non-negative
constraints.formulation: $\\forall n = 1, \\dots, N,\\; \\forall w = 1, \\dots, W-1:\\; WestFlow_{n,w} \\geq 0 \\quad \\text{and} \\quad \\forall n = 1, \\dots, N-1,\\; \\forall w = 1, \\dots, W:\\; NorthFlow_{n,w} \\geq 0$

WestFlow.definition: Equals 1 if the path uses the horizontal arc from intersection (n,w) to (n,w+1), and 0 otherwise

NorthFlow.definition: Equals 1 if the path uses the vertical arc from intersection (n,w) to (n+1,w), and 0 otherwise
